description: Source code for an IPC service backend implementation using icmsg in Zephyr OS, specifically for the 'ipc_icmsg_me_initiator' backend, managing endpoint registration, message sending, and binding.

methods.name: bound
methods.description: Handles binding event for the IPC endpoint.

methods.name: received
methods.description: Handles received data for the IPC endpoint, processes endpoint configuration or data accordingly.

methods.name: store_id_for_token
methods.description: Stores an endpoint ID in the backend data and assigns a token.

methods.name: register_ept
methods.description: Registers a new endpoint with the backend, including configuration and sending discovery messages.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message through the IPC endpoint.

methods.name: backend_init
methods.description: Initializes the backend device, including mutex and internal data.
